messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑look table of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Observed” dates are the ones actually taken off when the statutory holiday falls on a weekend.)

| Holiday | Observed Date | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|---------------|-------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 2, 2023 | Monday | Dec 30 – Jan 2 |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, etc.) | Feb 20, 2023 | Monday | Feb 18 – Feb 20 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7, 2023 | Friday | Apr 7 – Apr 9 |
| Victoria Day | May 22, 2023 | Monday | May 20 – May 22 |
| Canada Day | Jul 3, 2023 (observed) | Monday | Jul 1 – Jul 3 |
| Labour Day | Sep 4, 2023 | Monday | Sep 2 – Sep 4 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9, 2023 | Monday | Oct 7 – Oct 9 |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 13, 2023 (observed) | Monday | Nov 11 – Nov 13 |
| Christmas | Dec 25, 2023 | Monday | Dec 23 – Dec 25 |

> **Note:**  
> • Boxing Day (Dec 26, 2023) fell on a Tuesday, so it did **not** create a long weekend.  
> • Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, or the “St. John’s Day” holiday in Ontario) that may create extra long weekends for residents of those provinces.  
> • If you’re targeting a specific province, let me know and I can tailor the list accordingly.
